ledger_fit_attempt.note: A single-credit fit DTI_i = c*N_i/(0.2*N_i + 0.8*G) over the whole ledger DEGENERATES (the optimiser drives G to its lower bound and R^2 < 0): the ledger mixes files of different field quality, so emitted mass and credit per pixel are confounded and G is not identifiable this way. The identifying information is inside one family, and that calibration lives in registry/emission_model.json (built by scripts/build_submission.py from the 0.2600 and 0.2778 members). Provenance of the ledger: owner-reported scores.
